about: The $15 a week chain: which meter_daily rows count against it. Read by apps/control-plane/api/_meter.ts (chainFamily, chainWeekSum, chainWeekSpend). A unit counts when its unit_kind is agent (any model provider) and its unit_key matches one family below. Weeks start Monday 00:00 UTC.
ruling: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-14): content-engine's $15 a week chain cap, measured by the unit keys and weekly sums in docs/proposals/2026-11-14-phase3-and-chain-cap.md (his words: "I agree with everything else until Batch 6")
skip_note: Optional runs the daily sweep (the triage sweep, 03:00 UTC) skips once the week passes weekly_usd, in this order, inspirationhouse tagging first. Recorded as job chain_cap in content_engine_runs, where the run reads it, with one board item a week (apps/control-plane/api/_chainCap.ts). The fact gate on a piece Krish picked is never skipped, whatever this list says.

left_out.aeo-*: AEO-Engine is a specialist with a spend cap of its own (fleet audit aeo-2).
left_out.apify actors: a pay-as-you-go ceiling pool, never a target (Control Center protocol, credit_mode); and unit_kind actor never counts.
left_out.Control Center's own agents: daily-move, ai-mirror, nell-*, network-intent and the n8n/* nodes are its agents, not this chain.
left_out.Claude Code on his subscription: tokens with no dollar amount; never in meter_daily.
